'''Sweetcake''' or '''sweet cake''' was a type of cake and came in varieties such as the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] ''[[ryshcate]]''.<ref name="XW:RS"/> It was a favorite not only of legendary [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garen Muln]], but also of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]].

As a figure of speech, "piece of sweetcake" was used in a cavalier way to reference as being 'easy' what in reality was, for most, a very difficult situation.
